properties.Title: Force Government to Pay Back
properties.UserDescription:
Enable tax-exemption of backpay. Defaulted Amount might be 0, because missclick.
Defaulted Amount needs to be paid back, but the entire amount needs to be noted on the Bonds Tracking account, due to partial defaults likely not firing the Repaid Event.
To see whether this is actually true, we would need to compare the CustomStat with Bonds Tracking account. If both are equal, this assumption is true and everything is working as intended.
